exposure: Pelvic floor dimensions (anteroposterior diameter (APD) of the levator hiatus and the angle of progression (AoP))
Women without levator ani muscle coactivation
Women with levator ani muscle contraction on Valsalva maneuver (i.e. coactivation)
outcome: Duration of the second stage of labor
finding: Smaller pelvic floor dimensions and levator ani muscle coactivation are associated with higher fetal head station and with a longer second stage of labor in nulliparous women at term.
